contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CONSTANTIN[VS--] ; R/ [SOLI INVICTO] COMITI

Copper Alloy. Coin: Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Soli Invicto Comiti issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTIN[VS--]. Reverse description: Sol standing left holding globe. T F in field. Reverse inscription: [SOLI INVICTO] COMITI. In exergue: ?PRT? Diameter: 23.0mm, Weight: 2.71gms, die axis: 6
